data.name: RAZE BONE
data.detailed_description:
Raze Bone

Raze Bone is a spooky co-op survival game for up to 5 players, where fragile skeletons explore strange, shifting worlds, mix colorful crystals, and try not to fall apart along the way.

💎 MIX, MATCH & EXPERIMENT

Statues don't simply hand you the crystal they need.

You'll find plenty of base-color crystals throughout the world and combine them to create new ones. Figuring out the right combination is usually easier than it sounds — and you can experiment freely.

Try a few colors together, see what happens, and work your way toward the color you need.

Mix something wrong?

No big deal. You'll have plenty of ways to find more crystals and try again.

Once you've found the right color, there's still the offering to consider. Statues can ask for a certain amount of crystal points, while things like purity and size can make a difference too.

🗿 MAKE THE OFFERING

Statue requirements can change with the level, difficulty, biome, and current state of the run.

Complete an offering and the world moves forward.

Biomes shift, structures change, new areas appear, and the challenges become tougher.

Every successful offering pushes the run somewhere new.

⛏️ PLENTY OF WAYS TO GET CRYSTALS

You won't be stuck mining crystals all day.

Find them in mines and biome-specific areas, fight creatures, turn ordinary loot into crystals, trade with merchants, or discover hidden treasures.

The world gives you plenty of options. How you get what you need is up to you.

💀 AND YES, YOU CAN FALL APART

You're a skeleton. Heavy hits can send your bones flying.

Luckily, your friends can pick up the pieces and put you back together.

So explore, experiment, fight, mix some questionable colors, and keep moving.

Just don't forget where you left your head.
